snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Story Trailer | Warhammer
snippet.description:
The release of Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV draws closer! Check out the new story trailer now, and find out which faction will be gracing your screens alongside the Orks and Blood Ravens.

Excited? Find out more here: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/articles/amsujx55/the-blood-ravens-are-not-alone-in-a-new-warhammer-40000-dawn-of-war-iv-story-trailer/
